messages:
Alex: quick heads-up: after v2.4.0 a user reported our edge-starter hangs on Cloudflare Pages build with `Cannot find module` during worker init.
Priya: hmm, did we switch to conditional `exports` only? that can break non-node bundlers.
Sam: we removed `main/module` and relied on `exports` for import/require. package.json has "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }, "./*": "./dist/*" }.
Jess: many static bundlers rewrite imports to the package root or expect an `index.mjs` or `browser` field. conditional exports can be ignored.
Alex: reproduction: `git clone examples/edge-starter && yarn && yarn build` then Pages build fails when the bundler resolves a runtime chunk to the package root.
Priya: quick fix in the starter: create a small top-level `index.mjs` that re-exports the ESM dist: `export * from './dist/esm/index.js'` — that made the build succeed.
Sam: agree we should publish a patch: add top-level `module`/`main`/`types` fallbacks and maybe an `edge` export target. Also include an `index.mjs` in package root for bundlers that look for it.
Jess: add a CI smoke check for examples/edge-starter that runs an esbuild/rollup pass (no full runtime) so packaging regressions fail fast. I'll open the PR for CI.
Priya: note for TS users: put `types` at top-level too, TS sometimes misses conditional `types` inside `exports`.
ci-bot: build #2552 finished on main (no edge smoke test yet).
Alex: plan: patch release v2.4.1 to add fallbacks + index.mjs, add CI smoke test, update onboarding note about edge packaging quirks. assigning Sam/Jess to ship.
